question: Who among the following has written the novel ‘The Blue Umbrella’?
solution:
​The correct answer is** __Ruskin Bond.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Blue Umbrella is a **1980 Indian novel written by Ruskin Bond.**
 
• It was adapted into a **2005 Hindi film by the same name **which later won the** National Film Award for Best Children's Film.**
 
• **A prolific Anglo-Indian writer** in English,** Ruskin Bond **has written novels, short stories,** non-fictional pieces and essays for children.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Vikram Seth CBE, FRSL is an **Indian novelist and poet. **
 
• Aravind Adiga is an **Indian writer and journalist.**
 
• Devdutt Pattanaik is a** mythologist from Mumbai, India.​​**
